retake-practice-aug25d-d16f01083fdd-v1.quote: Odd-chain fatty acids undergo beta-oxidation until the final three-carbon fragment is propionyl-CoA. retake-practice-aug25d-ec0404bdf1d1-v1.quote: Acyl-CoA synthetase activates a fatty acid to fatty acyl-CoA at a cost equivalent to two ATP. retake-practice-aug25d-a960b02ed039-v1.quote: Purine salvage attaches preformed bases to ribose phosphate donated by PRPP. retake-practice-aug25d-d43805fc361e-v1.quote: Adenosine deaminase normally participates in degradation of adenosine and deoxyadenosine. retake-practice-aug25d-59935f943218-v1.quote: Heme consists of ferrous iron coordinated within protoporphyrin IX and is made chiefly in erythroid precursors and liver. retake-practice-aug25d-de36d819204a-v1.quote: Electrons from NADH enter at Complex I and those from succinate-linked FADH2 enter at Complex II; both routes converge on coenzyme Q, Complex III, cytochrome c, and Complex IV. retake-practice-aug25d-95bf89fbd5ef-v1.quote: For a simple Michaelis-Menten enzyme, velocity rises hyperbolically with substrate concentration and approaches Vmax as active sites become saturated. retake-practice-aug25d-dfd527770bc2-v1.quote: Protein kinases transfer a phosphate from ATP to specific amino-acid side chains, most often serine, threonine, or tyrosine.
